name: Ryan Specialty Holdings, Inc.

geography.fx_notes: 'Majority of revenue generated from the United States' (PitchBook); small UK/Europe (Lloyd's/delegated authority) presence. Exact split not extracted.

kpis.name: Gross debt / EBITDA
kpis.value: ~4.7x on PitchBook GAAP-basis EBITDA ($0.82bn); ~3.6x on company adj EBITDAC (ESTIMATE: $3.7bn / ~$1.03bn TTM)

acquisitions.earnouts: Contingent consideration expense $34.2m 9M-26; $37.4m paid 9M-26; Q3-26 $10.7m benefit incl. $12.9m reduction in US Assure liability (higher loss ratios) (S2)
acquisitions.notes: Business combinations 9M-25 $636.9m (incl. US Assure, Innovisk, Velocity etc. - names not verified here); FY25 acquisitions contributed ~10pts of 21% growth (S3)
Company reports no business combinations in 9M-26 (reported zero, not missing)

management.senior_turnover_5y: Planned 2024 succession: founder Pat Ryan to Executive Chairman, Jeremiah Bickham to President
management.succession_notes: Orderly founder-to-insider handover; founder remains executive officer
management.guidance_record: FY26 organic guide cut from high-single-digit to mid-single-digit during 2026; margin guide now 'down modestly' (S2)

ownership.controlling_holders: Founder Patrick G. Ryan: beneficial owner of ~127.4m shares (13G, 31-Dec-2023) via Class A/B units in Up-C; current % voting power not extracted from 2026 proxy
ownership.board_independence: not reviewed (2026 proxy elects 5 nominees for one-year terms)
ownership.remuneration_notes: Large equity-based compensation (IPO awards) depresses GAAP earnings; not reviewed in detail
ownership.related_party: Up-C with Tax Receivable Agreement benefiting pre-IPO LLC unitholders (standard Up-C feature; amounts not extracted)

A.rationale: Wholesale/MGA flows renew, but E&S volume and property rates make revenue cyclical.

evidence: Delegated underwriting authority and specialist wholesale relationships (S1)
B.rationale: Specialist E&S expertise and carrier capacity access are hard to replicate.

C.rationale: Scale in US wholesale but margin now slipping.

evidence: E&S market share gains drove 15%+ organic 2022-23 (S4)
D.rationale: Long structural E&S/MGA runway, cyclically paused.

G.rationale: Reasonable pivot to buybacks; leverage elevated.

H.rationale: Founder-controlled Up-C with TRA weakens minority protection (noted neutrally as controlling holder).

evidence: Wholesale placement of complex E&S risks (S1)
I1.rationale: Complex risks resist automation, but binding-authority small-risk flow is exposed to digital E&S platforms (INFERENCE).

evidence: Mgmt expects property pricing to deteriorate into 2027 (S2)
J.rationale: High sensitivity to property E&S pricing cycle.

evidence: TTM GAAP NI $105m vs FY25 adj EBITDAC $967m (S1,S3)
K.rationale: Large gap between GAAP and adjusted earnings (equity comp, amortisation, Up-C).

sector_specific.organic_ex_rate_note: INFERENCE: Q3-26 organic 4.0% vs 15.0% a year earlier while 'property softening squeezes E&S'; management cites new clients and casualty growth. With property rates down ~10% (Marsh index), underlying new-business/volume growth is perhaps high-single-digit with rate a negative 3-5pt drag in property-heavy lines.
sector_specific.contingent_consideration: 9M-26 expense $34.2m; paid $37.4m; US Assure liability reduced $12.9m in Q3-26 (S2); balance not extracted

gates.notes: G1 = B: PitchBook gross debt/EBITDA ~4.7x (> 4.0x broker threshold); on company adj EBITDAC ~3.6x (ESTIMATE) - basis difference needs reconciliation with lead agent. G4: GAAP NI depressed by non-cash comp/Up-C; FCF/NI likely >100% - not computed here.

bull_points: Structural share gains of E&S/delegated authority market; 16%/15%/13%/10% organic 2022-25.
Founder-aligned ownership; disciplined pause in M&A and buybacks at depressed price.
Casualty E&S still growing (US excess casualty rates +13%).
bear_points: Organic slowing sharply (4.0% Q3-26); property softening expected to worsen into 2027.
Leverage 4.7x on provider EBITDA; margins guided down; comp growing faster than revenue.
Founder-controlled Up-C with TRA; GAAP earnings a fraction of adjusted.
thesis_breakers: Adj EBITDAC margin < 30% for a full year.
